ConditionPredicate.description: A bounded typed comparison, with no executable user expressions.
ConditionPredicate.title: ConditionPredicate

ConditionalPolicy.description: If the optional group matches, require a separate comparison.
ConditionalPolicy.title: ConditionalPolicy

ContributeStrategy.description: Add a fixed amount every period, split by target weights or into the most underweight.
ContributeStrategy.title: ContributeStrategy

EventHypothesis.description: A documented event→issuer→security lead; never a measured or causal impact.
EventHypothesis.title: EventHypothesis

FocusDetail.description: Code-owned focus metadata. ``score`` is an inspectable heuristic, never a forecast.
FocusDetail.title: FocusDetail

HoldingReturn.description: Trailing 1-year return of one held position (null for cash or a too-short history).
HoldingReturn.title: HoldingReturn

InvestmentGoal.description: User-stated objective, never a promise of an achievable return.
InvestmentGoal.title: InvestmentGoal

InvestorContext.description: Optional global context. Jurisdiction is context, not a sourced tax policy.
InvestorContext.title: InvestorContext

InvestorRequirement.description: Explicit input, denominated in reporting currency; not an inferred liability.
InvestorRequirement.title: InvestorRequirement

MarketObservationResponse.title: MarketObservationResponse

PrivateAssetValuation.description: User or imported valuation, paired with its independently sourced FX receipt.
PrivateAssetValuation.title: PrivateAssetValuation

RebalanceStrategy.description: Bring weights back to today's target on a calendar or when one drifts past a band.
RebalanceStrategy.title: RebalanceStrategy

RegionalCompany.description: OpenDART sends name, englishName and stockCode; J-Quants adds the listing fields.
RegionalCompany.title: RegionalCompany

RegionalFinancialRow.description:
J-Quants summary rows carry disclosureNumber; OpenDART rows carry receiptNumber and the report keys.

Amounts are exact decimal strings as reported, never floats; a missing amount is null, not zero.
RegionalFinancialRow.title: RegionalFinancialRow

RegionalResearchResponse.description: GET /intelligence/regional. `status` "unavailable" (no usable account) has empty lists and a `reason`.
RegionalResearchResponse.title: RegionalResearchResponse

RiskGuardStrategy.description: Move part of the growth assets to a defensive asset after a fall; move back once it recovers.
RiskGuardStrategy.title: RiskGuardStrategy

RuleDifference.description:
One rule of a two-profile comparison, aligned by ruleId (rules SPEC §6, EF-10).

A is the first batch item, B the second. A side without that rule has nulls for its fields.
RuleDifference.title: RuleDifference

WorldPortfolioAssessment.description: Completed holdings screen using the record's available source evidence.
WorldPortfolioAssessment.title: WorldPortfolioAssessment
